Map these settings to a ping type
fields.definition:
Active - This is generated manually by the player, by pressing a button on their controller.  This behavior will override passive behavior.  

Passive - This is a constant ping, automatically generated by the tracking system.  Use this to mark things automatically as the player comes into range.  

You should create at most one block of Spartan Tracking data for each ping type.  If you have more, only the first will be used.

fields.name: ping type^#ping type to which these settings apply
priority#category used to limit the number of simultaneously marked targets
outline color index#index into outline material's 4-color 'outline_color' parameter
outline intensity:(0,1] - if 0, default from tracking globals tag will be used
outline thickness:(0,1] - if 0, default from tracking globals tag will be used
nav point screen#name of the screen used to mark this object when hit by a ping
nav point label#label displayed via the nav point screen
nav point vertical offset:world units#offset used when displaying the nav point screen and label
Range Override
fields.definition: Leave the override set to 0 if you'd like to use the default range.  A set of default ranges, for each ping type, is stored under the Spartan Tracking section of globals.globals.  Each set specifies a default range for each target priority.
